title: [finding] spec(migrations): the published entry `ui-object-grid-page-size-positive-integer-refused` says a stored page is refused on its next save; nothing on the save path judges component props
body:
Filing gate: **① class (a), published text that is false**. `reach:` exception, release text. The entry ships in the `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` tag, and `os migrate meta` prints it to authors. It is the same class as #20773, #20467 and #17561 (closed): an ADR-0087 entry whose text does not state what the platform does.

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_018fxqvRJW12TaHC7DUQ89Y6`, seat post #6017). The source is the at-tier contract review `5911769271` on PR #20856 (#20831), ③, where the reviewer escalated this to the seat; the #20831 dev noted it first. ⛔ Filed bare: grading and routing are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the author reads

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-object-grid-page-size-positive-integer-refused.ts`, `acceptanceCriteria` (the copy in `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` is generated from it):

> A stored page whose `object-grid` node carries `pageSize: 0` is refused on its next authoring-path save with a per-key issue at `pagination.pageSize`

## What the tree does (`origin/main` `40d6c5fbd`, read at this stamp)

- `PageComponentSchema.properties` is `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:324`). The page save path therefore never parses a component's props against `ComponentPropsMap`.
- `validateComponentProps` / `ComponentPropsMap` have **0** hits in `packages/metadata-protocol/src` and `packages/objectql/src` (non-test). Control: the same grep finds `validateComponentProps` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:113`.
- The one judge is the lint rule registered at `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (≈`:985-1027`): `tier: 'advisory'`, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`. So a `pageSize: 0` is reported as an advisory `component-props-invalid` finding on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, and a save succeeds.
- The #20831 PR's own entry (`ui-object-block-grouping-config-typed`, PR #20856) states this correctly: "A page component's `properties` are not parsed on the metadata save path".

⛔ Not measured: an actual save through `PUT /api/v1/meta/page` with `pageSize: 0`. The reading is a code read; the claiming dev measures it first.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Correct the sentence at the entry to say what happens: an advisory `component-props-invalid` finding at `pagination.pageSize` on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, with the page still saving and loading. Regenerate `registry.ts` with its generator, as #20773 did. Check the entry's sibling `object-grid-default-filters-rule-array` the same way. The dev reports it already says advisory.

Dedupe: `search_issues` "ui-object-grid-page-size-positive-integer-refused migration entry refused on authoring-path save component props advisory CLI only" in objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed: 13 hits. The closest are #20649, #17561 and #20696 (other entries' text, closed); none covers this entry.
Dedupe words: `page-size authoring-path save refused` · `component-props advisory CLI_ONLY entry` · `ui-object-grid-page-size-positive-integer-refused`
